verdict.rationale: AutoGen docs explicitly describe GraphFlow-style 'multi-agent workflows through a directed graph of agents' plus Swarm handoff-based transitions and RoundRobin/Selector team patterns, covering branching and sequencing; AutoGen Studio also supports declarative team/workflow building. Missing for 10: explicit documented support for parallel/fan-out steps and loop constructs beyond round-robin repetition, and independent hands-on verification of complex graph workflows.
